description: Central BetInsight country/provider eligibility data for the provider page, Premium and Premium Plus. Browser-readable; no Make/Sheet lookup on page view.
country_source: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; XK added as a practical Kosovo code
region_source: US states + District of Columbia; Austrian federal states
providers_format: names_only; a provider can later be replaced by an object with name/url/crypto_status

AT.note_de: Sportwetten werden in Österreich auf Landesebene geregelt. Deshalb erfolgt die Freigabe bundeslandbezogen.
AT.note_en: Sports betting in Austria is regulated at federal-state level, so provider approval is handled by federal state.

BR.source_name: Ministério da Fazenda / SPA – Empresas Autorizadas
BR.note_de: Enthalten sind die Marken aus dem aktuellen bundesweiten SPA-Register der administrativ autorisierten Unternehmen. Nur die jeweilige brasilianische .bet.br-Variante ist damit gemeint. Gerichtlich vorläufig zugelassene Sonderfälle sind nicht in dieser Standardliste enthalten.
BR.note_en: Includes brands from the current federal SPA register of administratively authorised companies. This refers to the respective Brazilian .bet.br offering. Operators active only under interim court orders are not included in this standard list.

CH.note_de: Online-Sportwetten dürfen in der Schweiz nur von Swisslos und Loterie Romande angeboten werden. Regionale Produktverfügbarkeit kann variieren.
CH.note_en: Online sports betting in Switzerland may only be offered by Swisslos and Loterie Romande. Regional product availability may vary.
